{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_data = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Now compute average revenue per converted order for each channel, stratified by customer segment
# Only include rows where converted = 1
converted_data = filtered_data[filtered_data['converted'] == 1]

# Group by channel and customer_segment and compute mean revenue
stratified_avg_revenue = converted_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')

# Access the values directly using .loc
email_loyal = stratified_avg_revenue.loc[('email', 'loyal')]
paid_search_loyal = stratified_avg_revenue.loc[('paid_search', 'loyal')]
difference_loyal = email_loyal - paid_search_loyal

email_returning = stratified_avg_revenue.loc[('email', 'returning')]
paid_search_returning = stratified_avg_revenue.loc[('paid_search', 'returning')]
difference_returning = email_returning - paid_search_returning

email_new = stratified_avg_revenue.loc[('email', 'new')]
paid_search_new = stratified_avg_revenue.loc[('paid_search', 'new')]
difference_new = email_new - paid_search_new

# Print the differences
print(f"Loyal customers: email - paid_search = {difference_loyal}")
print(f"Returning customers: email - paid_search = {difference_returning}")
print(f"New customers: email - paid_search = {difference_new}")"}
